title: 第6章 买阿曼尼的都是有钱人
novel_title: 修仙回来后我儿孙满堂了
content_zh:
几人将东西都收拾好后，已经晚上八点了。

    海景壹号附近不远处便有不少商场，郁凡随意找了一家高档餐厅便带着孩子们进去了。

    郁嘉庆夫妻从来没有来过高档餐厅显得有些畏畏缩缩，郁景和郁颜因为工作原因倒是进过这类餐厅，郁凌更不用说，初生牛犊不怕虎，无所畏惧。

    服务员递上菜单，郁嘉庆打开菜单便惊呼了一声，好贵！

    这边的消费都这么高吗？！

    对于一个从来没有进过高档餐厅的人来说，似乎一顿饭3000元有些贵了。

    可对于刚刚花了2.1亿买了房子的郁凡来说，自认为已经大致的了解了海市的物价，觉得价格还是合理的。

    五人大块朵硕了一番，不由觉得这个钱花得真的值，好吃才是王道。

    郁凡对于这些食物倒是没有多大想法，刷卡付账后，便准备回家。

    可郁颜却叫住了他，“额，爷爷，等等，您需不需买几套衣服？”

    郁颜总觉得对着这张和自己差不多大的脸叫爷爷有些尴尬。

    郁凡打量了一番自己略显奇异的衣服，再看看四周穿着现代服饰的人，似乎确实有必要买几套衣服了。

    至于头发，嗯，还是保持原有的长度吧。

    步行至大金国际中心，商城里各种高端品牌琳琅满目。

    几个孩子瞪大了眼睛四处看着，虽然他们买不起，可看还是能看的，这种能长见识的时候可不多！

    郁颜的眼睛都快黏在隔壁香奈儿门店上了。

    强迫自己收回眼光，想着先给爷爷买衣服，虽说大品牌买不起，可是总有价格较为便宜的店面。

    郁凡看着几个孩子努力在克制自己的模样，不由得笑了笑。

    “走吧，带你们去看看。”郁凡直接朝香奈夫人店走去。

    “爷爷，香奈夫人是奢侈品店，衣服价格都非常高的，主要经营的是女装和女士用的物品。”郁颜忙说，想要阻止自己爷爷。

    郁凡倒是直接说：“没有男装，那就买女装，你和你妈妈都来选选自己喜欢的衣服。”

    盛素华连忙说道：“爸，我就算了，我带了衣服过来，家里衣服也不少。”

    虽说都是穿了好几年的衣服，可是都还好好的，还是不要浪费了。

    郁凡理解儿媳的想法，无非就是节约用钱，可是如今他已经回来了，自然不会让这群孩子再受苦了。
content_en:
After several people packed up their things, it was already eight o'clock in the evening.

There are many shopping malls not far away from Seaview One. Yu Fan randomly found a high-end restaurant and took the children in.

Yu Jiaqing and his wife had never been to a high-end restaurant and looked a little timid. Yu Jing and Yu Yan had been to such restaurants due to work reasons, not to mention Yu Ling. Newborn calves are not afraid of tigers and have nothing to fear.

The waiter handed over the menu. Yu Jiaqing opened the menu and exclaimed, "It's so expensive!"

Is the consumption here so high?!

For someone who has never been to a high-end restaurant, 3,000 yuan for a meal seems a bit expensive.

But for Yu Fan, who had just spent 210 million to buy a house, he thought he had a general understanding of the prices in Haishi and felt that the prices were reasonable.

The five of us had a big meal, and couldn't help but feel that the money was really worth spending, and delicious food is the king.

Yu Fan didn't think much about the food. After paying with his card, he was ready to go home.

But Yu Yan stopped him, "Uh, grandpa, wait, do you need to buy a few sets of clothes?"

Yu Yan always felt a little embarrassed to call her grandpa in front of a face that was about the same size as her own.

Yu Fan looked at his slightly strange clothes, and then looked at the people wearing modern clothes around him. It seemed that he really needed to buy a few sets of clothes.

As for the hair, well, let’s keep it at its original length.

Walk to Daikin International Center, where you will find a variety of high-end brands in the mall.

Several children looked around with their eyes wide open. Although they couldn't afford it, they could still see it. There were not many times when they could learn something like this!

Yu Yan's eyes were almost glued to the Chanel store next door.

I forced myself to look back and thought about buying clothes for my grandpa first. Although I couldn't afford the big brands, there were always stores with cheaper prices.

Yu Fan couldn't help but smile when he saw the children trying to restrain themselves.

"Let's go, I'll take you to have a look." Yu Fan walked directly towards Mrs. Chanel's shop.

"Grandpa, Mrs. Chanel is a luxury store. The prices of clothes are very high. It mainly sells women's clothing and items for women." Yu Yan said hurriedly, trying to stop her grandfather.

Yu Fan said directly: "If there are no men's clothes, then buy women's clothes. You and your mother can choose the clothes you like."

Sheng Suhua said quickly: "Dad, I'll forget it. I brought clothes over, and there are a lot of clothes at home."

Although the clothes have been worn for several years, they are still in good condition, so don’t waste them.

Yu Fan understands his daughter-in-law's thoughts, which are nothing more than saving money, but now that he is back, he will naturally not let these children suffer anymore.
title_en: Chapter 6 Those who buy Armani are rich people
